studies.title: Technical studies and analysis
studies.description: High-precision fieldwork, specialized measurements, and environmental component analyses designed to meet the strictest regulatory standards.
studies.i1_desc: Environmental noise monitoring (D.S. 38 MMA), occupational noise (D.S. 594 MINSAL), fauna-component noise (SEA-MMA), underwater noise, illuminance and vibration monitoring.
studies.i2_desc: PM10, PM2.5, PM1 and TSP (DS 61/2008), settleable particulate matter, process gas monitoring, on-site meteorology.
studies.i3_desc: Physicochemical water analysis and hydrogeological monitoring.
studies.i4_desc: VES, ERT, TEM, and SP surveys up to 300 m depth. Exploratory drilling, test pits, soil mechanics, RTK topography, drone surveys, and bathymetry.
studies.i5_desc: Terrestrial and aquatic flora and fauna surveys with SAG and SUBPESCA-certified consultants, soil biology, and macroinvertebrates.
studies.i6_desc: Social risk analysis, social studies, and public participation processes (PAC).
studies.i7_desc: Each measurement is recorded and documented on-site, with full traceability for technical and regulatory purposes.
